doc: Task 8: a networked job reaches a listed fixture through its relay (200 through the proxy); after it ends, nothing labelled with its job is left. Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane (`requires: podman, linux`); the fixture is busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network), reached as fixture.drgnx.test pinned to 127.0.0.1. Unverified until the combined pass's host lane.

args: set -e; podman pull -q --policy=missing docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work $ROOT/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) (drgnx-agents-net-hosts ((packages "fixture.drgnx.test:18080" "fixture.drgnx.test:18081"))) (drgnx-sandbox-proxy-pinned-addresses (("fixture.drgnx.test" . "127.0.0.1"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

set -e; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-fixture-http -v $ROOT/www:/www:ro,z docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18080 -h /www >/dev/null

argv:
{ printf 'CONNECT fixture.drgnx.test:18080 HTTP/1.1
Host: fixture.drgnx.test:18080

'; sleep 1; printf 'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: fixture.drgnx.test
Connection: close

'; sleep 2; } | nc -w 5 127.0.0.1 3128 | grep fixture-ok && echo fetched

args: test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$job)"; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1; true
